text:
Katie (Support): Hey infra, customer ACME reporting repeated 503s and long tail latency since ~13:42 UTC. Example curl:

curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
< HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
< x-request-id: abcd-1234
<
{"error":"upstream inference worker error"}

ops-alert-bot: Incident created: INC-4800 - hosted-api-503s - severity:high :rotating_light:

Jon SRE: Seeing similar spikes on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Spike at 13:40, worker restarts increasing. Can you share request ids? Any model swap/quant rollout? :eyes:

Katie (Support): Request IDs: abcd-1234, efgh-5678. Customer says spikes correlate with large context payloads (~25k tokens). No rollout from their side. We did a quantized model swap at 13:30 for mpt-30b-redwood-quant.

Maria G (Infra): I pulled runner logs for host gpu-03-uw2: 

```
[13:38:52] infer-runner[pid=4321]: CUDA error: out of memory
[13:38:53] infer-runner[pid=4321]: segfault (signal 11) at 0x7f.....
[13:38:53] kernel: nv: GPU watchdog: GPU hung
[13:39:01] containerd: process exited with status 139
```

Devon P (Runtime): That looks like GPU OOM followed by sigsegv on quant runtime path. Likely triggered by a batch resize or unexpected long-context. We're seeing KV-prefetch memory growth for quant path. Rolling quant swap rollback recommended. Suggest immediate mitigations: 1) route traffic to non-quant model variant, 2) scale up Dedicated burst pool or fallback to cpu-hosted for these requests, 3) add strict context_token limit for hosted API.

Jon SRE: Applying routing fallback now: re-route mpt-30b-quant -> mpt-30b-fp16 in us-west-2. Also cordon gpu-03-uw2 and restart host. ETA ~5m. 

Maria G (Infra): I've collected coredump and nvcrash logs. Attaching short stack extract:

```
#0  0x00007fabcde in runtime::kv_prefetch() 
#1  0x00007fabfff in quant::decode() 
#2  0x0000555a in main_loop()
```

Katie (Support): Customer notified with temporary mitigation and asked for timeline. They reported a 45% error rate during the spike.

Devon P (Runtime): We'll revert quant rollout (feature flag qswap-2026-03) and push hotfix to prevent aggressive prefetch growth. Also add a guard in runtime to cap prefetch memory for quantized models.

Jon SRE: Host restarted. Error rate falling back to baseline. Reopening monitoring for 30m. :thumbsup:

ops-alert-bot: Incident INC-4800 updated: mitigated -> monitoring. 

Katie (Support): Thanks team — customer happy with mitigation, will keep them updated.

Maria G (Infra): Follow-up action items: 1) postmortem (owners: Devon+Maria), 2) add canary traffic limits for future quant swaps, 3) backfill tests for long-context quant inference.
